parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: DstDb
parameters.description: The ID of the instance on which the target SQL statement is executed. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the instance ID.

parameters.name: DstPassword
parameters.description: The password of the target SQL statement. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the password.

parameters.name: DstResId
parameters.description: The ID of the target SQL statement. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the ID.

parameters.name: DstUserName
parameters.description: The username of the destination instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

parameters.name: SlinkTaskDesc
parameters.description: The description of the target SQL statement.

parameters.name: SlinkTaskId
parameters.description: The task ID for executing the target SQL statement. > You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the IDs of target SQL statements supported by PolarDB-X.

parameters.name: SrcDb
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. Valid values: **enable**: enables the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. **disabled**: disables the source ApsaraDB RDS instance.

parameters.name: SrcPassword
parameters.description: The port number of the source instance. Valid values: 3200 to 3999. > This parameter is available and required only when **DBEndpointInstanceType** is set to **polardb-o**.

parameters.name: SrcResId
parameters.description: The ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the [DescribeDropSystemEventMetaList](~~196836~~) operation to query the details of all source ApsaraDB RDS instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: SrcResType
parameters.description: The type of the source instance. Valid values: RDS_MYSQL, POLARX1, POLARX2_STANDARD, POLARX2_ENTERPRISE, and POLARDB_M.

parameters.name: SrcUserName
parameters.description: The username of the source instance.
